en.help.title: Assembly Language Server (asm-lsp)
en.help.message:
"asm-lsp" provides completion, diagnostics, hover docs for opcodes/registers/directives, and go-to-definition for assembly (GAS, NASM, MASM). It requires Rust's cargo to install.

Optional per-project config: .asm-lsp.toml (choose assembler and instruction set).
See: https://github.com/bergercookie/asm-lsp
